name: Archbee
tagline: Archbee is a product documentation platform for creating internal wikis, API references, and public developer portals. Engineering and product teams use it to write and maintain technical documentation with version control, reusable content blocks, and AI writing assistance. It connects with GitHub for keeping API documentation in sync with code changes and lets teams publish branded documentation sites without separate hosting.
